description: Ministry of Higher Education & Highways - Order made to amend the Schedule to the Order published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 420/25 of 26.09.1986 which specifies the Faculties and the Departments of the Eastern University by adding the item '11. Department of Philosophy and Value Studies'.
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - an amendment to the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It contains an order made under statutory powers (Section 27(1)) that modifies the schedule specifying faculties and departments of a university. While it mentions a minister's name, this is in the context of exercising statutory authority to make a regulatory change, not about government personnel changes or portfolio assignments. The core content is legislative/regulatory in nature, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette.
